{'text': 'iPhone 邊框保護殼自 iPhone 4 推出以來一直深受粉絲喜愛，但近年的選擇越來越少。Rhinoshield 為追求簡約風格的用戶提供了一個不錯的選擇。', 'source': 'iPhone bumpers have been a fan favorite since the iPhone 4, but the options have dwindled in recent years. Rhinoshield provides a solid option for those after a minimalist aesthetic.'}

{'text': 'Apple 去年終於藉著 iPhone Air 重回邊框保護殼市場。我原本希望 Apple 會將其邊框保護殼擴展至 iPhone 18 Pro（就像當年推出透明保護殼搭配 iPhone 11 那樣），可惜最終並未成事。我在尋找其他選擇時，發現了 Rhinoshield 的 Minimalist Impact Bumper 邊框保護殼。', 'source': "Apple finally returned to the bumper case market last year with the iPhone Air. I had hoped Apple would extend its bumper case to the iPhone 18 Pro (as it did with the Clear Case for the iPhone 11), but it didn't. In my search for other options, I came across Rhinoshield's Minimalist Impact Bumper case."}

{'text': '重點細節', 'source': 'Key Details'}

{'text': 'Impact Bumper 邊框保護殼的貼合度與大部分其他邊框保護殼相似，螢幕邊緣的凸起較細，而機背邊緣的凸起則稍大。此保護殼有一個獨特設計，也是我相當喜歡的一點，就是設有特別的支撐結構，可讓鏡頭平台和鏡頭不會直接接觸擺放手機的表面；考慮到 17 Pro 和 18 Pro 都是鋁金屬機身，這點尤其令我欣賞。這使得它的保護性遠超一般邊框保護殼，同時亦解決了將手機放在平面使用時那惱人的搖晃問題。', 'source': 'The fit of the Impact Bumper is similar to most other bumpers, with a thin lip around the screen and a slightly larger one around the back. There is a unique design to this case that I quite like: a special support structure that keeps the camera plateau and the cameras from touching the surface you place your phone on. Given the aluminum bodies of the 17 Pro and 18 Pro, I especially appreciate this. It makes it far more protective than a typical bumper, and also solves the annoying wobble when using your phone on a flat surface.'}

{'text': '不過，保護殼的貼合度並未完全符合我的期望。它有點鬆，邊緣可以輕易向外掰開，我也擔心長久使用後邊緣可能會被撐鬆。不過我認為手機掉落時飛出保護殼的機會不大（而且我已意外地測試過）。話雖如此，整個保護殼的材質是硬塑膠而非橡膠，希望長遠使用也不成問題。Rhinoshield 表示，保護殼由單一材質製成，因此可以 100% 回收。', 'source': "The fit doesn't entirely live up to my expectations, though. It's a bit loose, the edges easily flex outward, and I'm worried they may stretch out over time. That said, I don't think the phone will fly out of it if dropped (I've inadvertently tested this). Still, the entire case is made of hard plastic instead of rubber, so I hope it holds up over time. According to Rhinoshield, the case is made from a single material, making it 100% recyclable."}

{'text': '保護殼提供三種顏色，與 iPhone 18 Pro 的機身顏色配襯：白色、藍色和黑色（抱歉，沒有酒紅色）。我選的藍色接近 Glacier 色調，但並非完全一樣。', 'source': 'The case is available in three colors that match the iPhone 18 Pro colors: White, Blue, and Black (sorry, no wine red). The blue I got is close to but not exactly the Glacier tone.'}

{'text': '缺點', 'source': 'Downsides'}

{'text': '不過，保護殼也有一些不足之處。我最主要的投訴是按鈕較難按壓。不知何故，他們採用了幾乎齊平的設計，加上按鈕本身的構造，按起來感覺軟綿綿的。', 'source': 'There are a few downsides to the case, though. My main complaint is that the buttons are hard to press. For some reason, they used an almost flush design, combined with the construction of the buttons themselves, making them feel mushy.'}

{'text': '整體材質選擇可能也是一個缺點。對我來說，它的質感比 Apple 的 iPhone Air 邊框保護殼廉價，但有些人可能反而更喜歡。比起一般 TPU 或橡膠透明保護殼的材質，我個人確實更傾向這種。它採用硬塑膠加上較鬆的設計，似乎特別容易吸附口袋裡的灰塵。', 'source': "The overall material choice might be a downside too. To me, it feels cheaper than Apple's iPhone Air Bumper, but some people may prefer it. I personally do prefer it over the typical TPU or rubber clear case material. It uses hard plastic with a looser design that seems particularly prone to attracting lint from your pocket."}

{'text': '如果你使用 Apple 的 Wrist Strap 或 Crossbody Strap，請注意此保護殼並沒有相關的掛繩連接位。', 'source': "If you use Apple's Wrist Strap or Crossbody Strap, be aware that this case has no lanyard attachment point."}

{'text': '總結', 'source': 'Conclusion'}

{'text': 'Rhinoshield 的邊框保護殼絕非完美，我仍然希望 Apple 能將其邊框保護殼擴展至其他 iPhone 型號。不過，最終我還是決定保留這個保護殼，原因只有一個：它讓我能夠享受近乎無保護殼的體驗，同時毋須擔心脆弱的鋁金屬邊框被刮花或撞凹。據我所知，這款邊框保護殼通常只在他們自家網站發售，定價約 30 美元，連運費後與 Apple 邊框保護殼的 39 美元定價相若。你可以在這裡購買 Rhinoshield Minimalist Impact Bumper 邊框保護殼。（偶爾 Amazon 上也會出現相關商品頁面，不妨試試看。）', 'source': "Rhinoshield's bumper case is far from perfect, and I still wish Apple would extend its bumper case to other iPhones. However, I decided to keep it in the end for one reason: it allows me to enjoy a near caseless experience without worrying about the fragile aluminum edges getting scratched or dented. To my knowledge, the bumper case is typically only sold on their own website and is priced at about $30, which with shipping is similar to Apple's bumper case at $39. You can buy the Rhinoshield Minimalist Impact Bumper case here. (Occasionally there's an Amazon listing, so check there too.)"}
